answer: Duplicating identities means buying new hardware vertices and repeating costly burns, so sybil floods scale linearly with real capital. Each agent must burn a ferrous token bound to a unique hardware vertex (a device fingerprint) and solve a quartz-seeded proof-of-work puzzle per epoch. Honest peers attest only valid vertex records, making fake identities expensive and easily pruned. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
